column2: Frequency of class preceding modal class: $f_0$
Frequency of class succeeding modal class: $f_2$
Modal Class: The class interval which has highest frequency
If n is Odd, Median = $\dfrac{n+1}{2}$ th term.
if n is even, Median = $\dfrac{n^{th} term + (n+1)^{th} term}{2}$
Median Class: we find cumulative frequencies of all class and then locate class $\dfrac{n}{2}$.
